common.telegramCopyFailed: Telegram opened an empty chat and your browser would not let us copy the message. Tell us which tour you are asking about and we will take it from there.

error.offlineBody: We cannot reach the network from here. Check your connection and reload, everything you had typed is still on this device.
error.staleBody: A newer version of the site went live while this tab was open, so part of it could not be fetched. Reloading picks up the new version and fixes this completely. Nothing is wrong with your booking.
error.unknownBody: This part of the page failed to load. Reloading usually fixes it. If it does not, message us and we will answer you directly, no form required.
error.reportMessage: Hello, I hit an error on your website.

common.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. Everything we offer is one click away.

home.heroLede: A licensed guide who knows the city, a car that waits for you, and an itinerary built around what you actually want to see. No groups. No coaches. No queues.
home.introTitle: The city arranged around you, not the other way round
home.introBody: We are a small private-travel outfit in Beyoğlu. We run private tours, charter boats on the Bosphorus, and move people around this city in cars that arrive on time. Everything is for your party alone. That is the whole proposition, and it is why nothing here is sold by the seat.
home.featuredLede: Eight itineraries we have refined over a decade. Every one of them can be rebuilt around your dates, your pace and your interests.
home.pillarsTitle: Three things that make the difference
home.bespokeTitle: Or tell us what you actually want
home.bespokeBody: Most of our work never appears on this page. Send us your dates and a sentence about what you are after: a first visit, a return trip that skips the obvious, a proposal, a family with three generations in it. We will write you an itinerary.
home.ctaBody: Tell us your dates. We reply within a few hours with a written itinerary built around them. Nothing is agreed until you have read it and said yes.

pillars.privateBody: Your party only. We never combine bookings, and nobody you did not invite gets in the car, on the boat or in front of the guide.
pillars.licensedBody: Every guide holds a Ministry of Culture licence, legally required inside museums, and quietly ignored by a lot of operators. Ours are historians and art historians.
pillars.flexibleBody: Want two hours in one museum instead of three rushed stops? Say so at 11am and the afternoon is rebuilt. The itinerary is a starting point, not a contract with you.

services.yachtsBody: Four boats, from a mahogany launch for two to a 24-metre motor yacht. Sunset runs, island days and celebrations.
services.fleetBody: Flights tracked, met inside arrivals, luggage carried. S-Class, V-Class and Sprinter, with child seats fitted before you arrive.
services.bespokeBody: Multi-day programmes, corporate groups, milestone trips. Written for you from scratch, not assembled from a menu.

experiences.title: Experiences
experiences.lede: Each of these is a starting point. Tell us which parts matter and we will rebuild the rest around them.
experiences.emptyBody: We are still adding to the catalog. In the meantime, tell us what you had in mind and we will build it.
experiences.railBody: Send us your dates. We reply within a few hours with a written itinerary and everything the day involves.
experiences.itineraryNote: Times are indicative. Your guide adjusts them on the day around the light, the crowds and you.

yachts.metaTitle: Private yacht and boat charters on the Bosphorus
yachts.title: Yacht charters
yachts.lede: The Bosphorus is best seen from it, not beside it. Four boats, each chartered whole and never by the seat.
yachts.occasionsTitle: Four ways to use a boat
yachts.charterNote: Crew, fuel and harbour fees are part of every charter.
yachts.ctaTitle: Tell us the date and the occasion
yachts.ctaBody: We will match the boat to the party and send you a written proposal. Catering, flowers, photographer and musicians are all arranged through us.

fleet.metaTitle: VIP airport transfers and chauffeured fleet in Istanbul
fleet.title: Transfers & fleet
fleet.lede: Tracked flights, a driver waiting inside arrivals with your name, and a car that is where it said it would be. Not a taxi with a nicer badge.
fleet.ctaBody: Send us your flight number and hotel. We confirm within the hour with the driver’s name and plate.

bespoke.title: Plan your journey
bespoke.lede: Four short steps, one question each. We reply within a few hours with a written itinerary, and nothing is agreed until you have read it and said yes.
bespoke.sendNote: There is no form handler collecting this in the background. Pressing a button below opens WhatsApp or your mail app with every answer already written out, nothing reaches us until you send it there.

fields.arrivalHint: Approximate is fine. We can work with a week.
fields.arrivalHintFlexible: Roughly when. We will propose the best window ourselves.
fields.flexibleNote: Noted. With open dates we plan around you rather than to a calendar, so neither answer above has to be exact.
fields.childSeat: Would you like a child seat?
fields.childSeatNote: Noted. We will prepare a seat suited to their age and confirm the details with you before the day.
fields.interests: What are you most interested in?
fields.interestsHint: Pick as many as you like.
fields.notesHint: Dietary needs, mobility, an occasion, something specific you have read about.
fields.name: Your name
fields.phoneHint: Pick your country, then the number as you would dial it at home.
fields.consent: I agree to Private VIP Istanbul contacting me about this enquiry.

pace.gentle: Gentle, one thing a day, long lunches
pace.balanced: Balanced, two or three stops, unhurried
pace.full: Full. I want to see everything

bespoke.successBody: Your enquiry is written out and waiting in WhatsApp or your mail app. Press send there and it reaches us. We reply within a few hours during Istanbul working hours, and always by the next morning. If nothing opened, your browser may have blocked the tab, use the button below.
bespoke.telegramCopied: Telegram cannot carry a prefilled message, so your enquiry has been copied to the clipboard. Paste it into the chat that just opened and press send.
bespoke.telegramCopyFailed: Telegram cannot carry a prefilled message, and your browser would not let us copy it. Go back and copy your answers, or use WhatsApp instead.

about.title: A small outfit in Beyoğlu
about.lede: We are not a booking platform and we are not a call centre. We are a licensed travel agency with a handful of guides we have worked with for years.
about.storyBody1: Private VIP Istanbul began because a friend asked for a guide who would not walk them past the Basilica Cistern reciting a Wikipedia entry. We found one. Then people kept asking, and at some point it became a business.
about.storyBody2: What has not changed is the size of it. We run a small number of tours well rather than a large number adequately, which means we occasionally have to tell someone we are full. We would rather do that than hand you to a guide we have not met.
about.storyBody3: Everything we sell, we have done ourselves. The restaurants are places we eat. The boats belong to captains we know by name. The buyer at the Grand Bazaar has turned down commission from every shop in it for twenty years, which is the only reason his opinion is worth anything.
about.licensedBody: Certificate no. {{number}}. Every guide we use holds a Ministry of Culture and Tourism licence, the one that is legally required inside museums.
about.insuredBody: As required of a licensed agency, with every vehicle and vessel separately insured for passengers.
about.englishGuides: English, Russian and Turkish as standard
about.englishGuidesBody: Arabic, German, French, Spanish and Italian available with notice.
about.noSharedGroupsBody: We have never combined two bookings and we are not going to start.
about.ctaBody: The office is in Asmalı Mescit and the coffee is good. If you are already in Istanbul, drop in, otherwise, write to us.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: WhatsApp is fastest and how most of our guests reach us. Email if you would rather have it in writing.
contact.whatsappBody: The quickest route to a person. Usually answered within the hour.
contact.telegramBody: Same speed as WhatsApp, if that is where you already are. Send your dates and we will reply there.
contact.phoneBody: If you are already in Istanbul and something needs solving now.
contact.emailBody: For detailed enquiries, corporate bookings and anything needing a paper trail.
contact.officeBody: Beyoğlu, a few minutes from İstiklal. Visitors welcome, a message first means the coffee is ready.
contact.formBody: The full planning form asks better questions and gets you a faster, more accurate answer.

faq.title: Questions
faq.lede: The things guests ask most. If yours is not here, ask us directly, we answer everything.
faq.stillBody: Message us. There is no sales script and nobody will chase you afterwards.

footer.tagline: Private tours, yacht charters and VIP transfers in Istanbul.

cookies.title: A quick note on analytics
cookies.body: We would like to use Google Analytics to see which pages are useful. It is optional, decline and no tracking script loads at all.

testimonials.t1: We had done Istanbul before, badly, in a group of forty. This was a different city. Our guide reorganised the whole afternoon when my husband’s knee gave out, and never once made it feel like a problem.
testimonials.t2: The buyer at the Grand Bazaar talked us out of two purchases and into one. We paid roughly half what we had been quoted the day before on our own.
testimonials.t3: Our balloon was cancelled for wind. The refund was in my account before we landed back in Istanbul, and nobody made me ask twice.
